resources.string: Resolves the addresses used by the app through an encrypted DNS server. Does not apply to the mpv player, external players and Chromecast.
Choose the server that resolves the addresses of the servers Nuvio connects to.
Host name (dns.example.com), IP address (1.1.1.1) or full https:// URL. Without a path, /dns-query is used.
IP addresses of the server, separated by commas. They let the app reach it without asking the device DNS.
Use the device DNS if the server does not answer
Keeps the app working when the DNS over HTTPS server is unreachable.
Uses the same DNS over HTTPS settings on the other devices of the profile.

When DNS over HTTPS is on, Nuvio sends the names of the servers it connects to to the chosen provider (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, Mullvad, OpenDNS or a custom server) to get their addresses. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by these providers.
Used for the network requests and the DNS over HTTPS lookups. Created by Square, Inc.
